
 Usage: houston config-import [OPTIONS] {settings_file}

 Apply a customer's exported settings (from a support dump) to a repro.

 Imports only settings the customer CHANGED from default, skipping secrets the
 dump redacts and identity/environment settings (license, Site_Url, assets)
 that would break or pollute a local repro.

╭─ Arguments ──╮
 *    settings_file      <str>  path to a support-dump *-settings.json [required]
╰──╯
╭─ Options ──╮
 --name     -n      <str>
 --only             <str>  comma-separated id prefixes, e.g. Livechat,LDAP,Accounts
 --dry-run                 show the import plan without changing anything
 --help                    Show this message and exit.
╰──╯
